title: B-SLIM: BART Sparse Linear Interactions Model for Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
abstract: arXiv:2611.33246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating covariate-dependent treatment effects is a central challenge in personalized medicine. Existing approaches often emphasize either fully parametric models, risking misspecification, or flexible machine learning methods, which may require large samples to detect the small treatment effect heterogeneity common in medical settings. We propose B-SLIM (BART Sparse Linear Interaction Model), a semi-parametric model for causal inference that combines a flexible Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) prognostic component with a sparse linear treatment effect component. This hybrid structure combines flexible prognosis modelling with interpretable treatment effects. The treatment effect component includes main effects and pairwise interactions, regularized through a global-local shrinkage prior. The model allows covariates to contribute to both components and provides direct inference on treatment effect modifiers, conditional mean

translated_title: B-SLIM：用于异质性治疗效应的BART稀疏线性交互模型
translated_abstract: 估计依赖于协变量的治疗效应是个性化医疗中的核心挑战。现有方法通常要么采用完全参数化模型（存在模型误设的风险），要么使用灵活的机器学习方法（可能需要大样本才能检测到医疗场景中常见的微小治疗效应异质性）。我们提出了B-SLIM（BART稀疏线性交互模型），这是一种用于因果推断的半参数模型，它将灵活的贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）预后组件与稀疏线性治疗效应组件相结合。这种混合结构将灵活的预后建模与可解释的治疗效应相结合。治疗效应组件包含主效应和成对交互效应，并通过全局-局部收缩先验进行正则化。该模型允许协变量同时对两个组件作出贡献，并提供对治疗效应调节因子的直接推断以及条件均……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出B-SLIM半参数因果推断模型，将灵活的BART预后建模与经全局-局部收缩先验正则化的稀疏线性治疗效应组件（含主效应和交互效应）相结合，兼顾模型灵活性、治疗效应可解释性以及对治疗效应调节因子的直接推断能力。
en_tdlr: B-SLIM is a semi-parametric causal inference model that combines a flexible BART prognostic component with a sparse linear treatment effect component (regularized via global-local shrinkage priors), balancing flexibility, interpretability of treatment effects, and direct inference on treatment effect modifiers.
